To layout recessed light fixtures, say with four recessed lighting fixtures on a square ceiling, 3 meters wide: First, divide the ceiling into how many recessed lighting fixtures you want to install.
Since we want four recessed lightings, we need to divide the ceiling into four equal squares on a 2-by-2 layout.
Finally, we place the recessed lighting fixtures at the center of each square, where their locations would be 1.5 meters / 2 = 0.75 meters away from the walls.
Installing 2 recessed lightings requires us to split the ceiling in half so that each fixture will illuminate the corresponding floor areas beneath them almost equally.
